llm_response.reason: The website at https://knob.chito.ru.com/ displays an almost exact copy of the Google search homepage on a non-Google domain (chito.ru.com), which is not affiliated with Google. The only links present are legitimate Google URLs, but the hosting on an unrelated subdomain is a classic case of a website mimicking the branding, interface, and navigation of a trusted entity. This matches scam characteristic 16: mimics legitimate company names, logos, and website designs; and potentially characteristic 10 if pop-ups/errors are used elsewhere. Domain registration is generic and not connected to Google. Spoof copies like this are often used in phishing, malware delivery, or credential harvesting scams.
